honesty_rules: Every simulated or scripted dashboard capture MUST keep visible SIMULATED / SCRIPTED badges on screen.
Every latency, gap, or timing number MUST be read directly off a real screen or measured run.
Numbers remain as ___ placeholders until populated from the tonight hardware run.
Real-rig footage MUST come exclusively from tonight hardware run.

segments.description: Black screen. Audio waveform freezes on stumble gap; red marker slams down. Riff pops in with speech bubble.
Fast kinetic collage: tapping phone app, rewinding video lesson, metronome swinging. No commercial brand logos.
Animated OmniRiff mascot hop + letter shockwave (#141). Tagline types on in pixel font: NEVER PUT THE GUITAR DOWN.
Wide establishing shot of physical rig on table with callout badges (Guitar In, Cam, One Pedal).
Player holds V / TALK button on laptop and speaks goal aloud: "My G to C change". Dashboard confirms.
Take with planted stumble. Dashboard shows Ears transient analysis, Eyes wrist kinematics, and zooms on ___ ms gap.
Riff plays back take, goes dry, and pauses. Prompt shows HOLD PEDAL TO APPROVE (or press Y). Close-up of foot holding pedal.
Fresh drill take. Dashboard before/after split displays: BEFORE ___ ms -> AFTER ___ ms. GAP bar turns green.
Dashboard result card and NEXT TIME recommendation. Memory file icon flies into Riff avatar.
Hand pinch-and-sweep filter gesture with skeleton overlay (Shot 7), then USB cam cable yanked mid-song (Shot 8).
Rapid motion-graphics assembly of the 12 system blocks from architecture.svg (audio, vision, firmware, router, dashboard, coach).
OmniRiff logo, identity line, and GitHub repository URL. Riff mascot waves goodbye. Optional team wave (Shot 9).

audio.line: Practising alone, every tool makes you stop. Apps grade notes. A teacher tells you why, but every week, for a fee.

audio.speaker: SM
audio.line: So we built a teacher that lives in your signal chain.

audio.speaker: SM
audio.line: Guitar in. Camera on. One pedal. That’s it.

audio.speaker: SM
audio.line: Riff listens with Ears, watches your hand with Eyes, and that ___ millisecond gap? Your strumming hand froze right at the change.

audio.speaker: SM
audio.line: It sets up the drill, plays your take back, but never touches your sound until you approve.

audio.speaker: SM
audio.line: A fresh drill take. Look at that: down to ___ milliseconds.

audio.speaker: SM
audio.line: And next session, it remembers right where you left off.

audio.speaker: SM
audio.line: Pinch to shape your tone. Unplug the camera, and the music keeps going.

audio.speaker: SM
audio.line: Real-time audio engine, hand tracking, and a LangChain deep agent with subagents, skills, and memory, built by four of us.

audio.speaker: SM
audio.line: OmniRiff. Never put the guitar down.
